title: Adoption Playbook: Harmonize Tokens, Controls, and Data Surfaces for Migration
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Produce a pragmatic, operations-ready adoption playbook that guides product teams through migrating from legacy tokens and component variants to the new design system primitives (tokens, button API, table patterns, chart wrappers) with minimal regressions. The playbook will live in the docs site as: migration lanes, clear do/don't examples, quick code snippets, API parity notes, and a lightweight checklist for engineers and designers.

Background: Multiple teams have started adopting component updates independently; fragments of migration guidance exist in various design tickets and PRs. This ticket consolidates those learnings, formalizes migration lanes (greenfield, incremental, compatibility-layer), and provides component-specific advice for data-dense surfaces and interactive controls.

Scope:
- Author migration lane descriptions and recommended upgrade path per component family: tokens, buttons, tables, charts.
- Provide at least 6 concise before/after examples (visual + code) for common anti-patterns.
- Document API mapping table (old prop -> new prop) as a simple CSV-like list inside the doc.
- Publish a one-page checklist and create a short rollout playbook for Platform/Eng reviewers.
- Link to GH PR templates, Figma variants, and a compatibility shim PR (engineering).

Out of scope: Automated codemods (separate infra ticket), deep accessibility audit (separate audit ticket).

Success metrics:
- Adoption docs page receives 150+ views by first release sprint.
- Two product teams complete migration checklist and sign off.
- <5 migration-related bugs reported in first month after rollout.
acceptance_criteria: A single docs site page (or section) exists with migration lanes and one-page checklist
At least 6 before/after code examples are included covering tokens, buttons, tables, charts
Component API mapping tables uploaded and linked to respective component reference pages
Design and Engineering have reviewed and approved content in a documented review comment thread
Playbook contains rollback guidance and testing checklist for data surfaces
tasks: Audit existing docs and collect prior migration notes (DES/PR references)
Draft migration lanes and high-level decision matrix
Create before/after visual examples in Figma and export PNGs for docsite
Write code snippets for React/vanilla JS consumers showing old->new API
Coordinate with Eng to surface compatibility shim PR and link to it
Run internal review with PMs and Platform Eng; update doc per feedback
Publish to staging docsite and validate rendering and TOC placement
Announce on #design-system + add to onboarding checklist
decisions: Keep migration playbook lightweight and action-oriented — deep technical migration guides will be separate tickets
Prefer promoting semantic tokens mapping over direct pixel token mapping to encourage intention-based use
Document three migration lanes: Greenfield, Incremental (compatibility shim), and Immediate Cutover
For tables and charts, prioritize conservative visual parity in Incremental lane to avoid regression of data readability
tradeoffs: Comprehensive guidance vs time-to-publish: we will prioritize commonly used patterns first and add rarer edge cases in follow-ups
Recommend compatibility shim to reduce immediate dev burden, but it may prolong reliance on legacy APIs
Keeping examples small improves clarity but may omit complex interactive edge cases—callouts will link to ticketed deep-dive docs
